Arize AI provides an enterprise platform (Arize AX) and open-source offering (Arize Phoenix) for AI observability, evaluation, and agent engineering. The platform supports tracing, monitoring, prompt optimization, and automated evaluations for both traditional ML and generative AI use cases. Headquartered in Berkeley, CA, the company serves enterprises including Booking.com, PepsiCo, Uber, and TripAdvisor. Founded in 2020 by Jason Lopatecki and Aparna Dhinakaran, Arize AI has raised over $131 million across five funding rounds, including a $70 million Series C in February 2025 led by Adams Street Partners.
